Deployed walkthrough of app.parfocal.eu on v0.28.1

86 work27 broken

Walked on 2026-11-20 between 17:15 and 17:55 on app.parfocal.eu after the deploy step of v0.28.1 passed, in the workspace ČVUT Biomedical Engineering, which holds the seeded cases. This is the walkthrough for backlog task TEST-056 (a walkthrough artifact of the whole deployed app).

The agent account is a researcher with admin rights and an owner of all three projects. No other seeded role could be signed in, so the reviewer and viewer sides were seen only as the read only state on tasks assigned to other people. The adjudicator role is not seeded at all.

86 steps work and 27 are broken, out of 113.

Smart select was armed three times and clicked three times, and each of these sent a server embedding call that the app made on its own. Cost of these calls: TODO, not measured. Everything drawn, the moved slide and the share link were removed or put back. The answers on the first slide of Showcase case review stay.

17 screenshots were taken, two over the limit of 15. Eight are in the HTML page.

Broken, ranked by how much it confuses or blocks a pathologist

1Every notification link opens Page not found

The Open button in the bell and on /notifications goes to /go/{notification id}, and the app shows Page not found. A reviewer who is told about a new task cannot reach it from the notice.

Likely cause: The API builds the link as /go/{id} in apps/api/src/parfocal_api/notifications.py:243. The web app has no /go route in apps/web/src/routes, and nothing calls GET /api/me/notifications/{id}/target, which exists in notification_targets.py:136. apps/web/src/shell/bell.tsx:108 and apps/web/src/screens/notifications/notifications-screen.tsx:40 navigate to the raw link.

2The two zip slides never open (MIRAX in a zip, DICOM in a zip)

CMU-1-Saved-1_16.zip and CMU-1-JP2K-33005-v2.zip show a grey stage and "This file format cannot be opened in the browser yet". The same slides are still offered in the Format gallery tour review task, in the new task wizard, in Run a model and in the slide switcher.

Likely cause: The viewer engine has no reader for these formats. createDefaultPixelSourceRegistry in packages/viewer-engine/src/pixel-source/registry.ts:82 registers openers only for the TIFF family, NDPI, BIF and Zarr, so registry.open throws UnsupportedFormatError for mirax and dicom. Details are in the zip section below.

3Smart select calls the paid server model without being asked, and has no Good choice

Pressing S posts /api/slides/{id}/embeddings/view at once, and every click posts it again. The bar shows only 1, 2, 3, 4 and Best, with no Good button and no pressed state on Best. The notice then says "Best is not answering yet, Good outlined this view". One click took more than 7 seconds to give a proposal, and Enter did not accept it.

Likely cause: apps/web/src/aiseg/view-embeddings.ts:56 requests the server embedding as soon as the tool is armed. The Good and Best choice is not a visible control in the context bar (apps/web/src/annotations/context-bar.tsx).

4Clear all deletes drawn regions, the ruler and the count marker with no question

In Annotate, the Objects tab button Clear all sent five DELETE calls at once, with no confirm step. It also left the empty group Group 1 behind.

Likely cause: apps/web/src/measure/measurement-list.tsx and apps/web/src/viewer/stage-measurements.tsx, the Clear all handler has no confirm step.

5A clinical report with no tumor cannot get past Staging

On the draft report, Next on the Staging step answers "Add at least one deposit" and "Confirm the category". A negative sentinel node case has no deposit, so the report cannot be finished by hand, although the seeded signed report is exactly such a case.

Likely cause: apps/web/src/screens/clinical-report/model.ts:223 refuses the step when values.deposits is empty.

6The co-sign request cannot be answered

Showcase co-sign says Ada Admin asks you to co-sign, but Co-sign and sign out is off with "You cannot sign out in this project. Ask the owner for the right." The account is an owner of that project.

Likely cause: The seed in apps/api/src/parfocal_api/showcase.py (seed_showcase_case) asks a person without the sign out right, or the right check in apps/api/src/parfocal_api/sign_out.py does not count project owners.

7Signed off and not signed at the same time

Team, Done tab, lists RT-2 as "Signed off 20 Nov" with Open the report. The report says "Evaluation v1, draft" and "Not signed yet", and /tasks/{id}/sign-off says "Ready to sign".

Likely cause: The seed marks the task state without writing an evaluation version, or apps/web/src/screens/team reads a different field than apps/web/src/screens/evaluation/evaluation-screen.tsx.

8The Objects tab in Annotate shows a raw class ID and renumbers shapes

Drawn regions are listed under Measurements, grouped under the heading "758df050-9ca7-4902-b81e-80d37d01b816" instead of the class name Tumor. After a reload the ruler that was M4 became M1 and the regions moved to M2, M3 and M4. Layers and groups sit in the Display tab, not in Objects.

Likely cause: groupName in apps/web/src/measure/measurement-list.tsx:32 prints group.name, which holds the class id. The M numbers are given by list order in apps/web/src/viewer/stage-measurements.tsx, not stored.

9Opening a slide writes a setting (PUT /api/me/setting-layers)

The body is {"values":{"hints_seen":["viewer.tool.select"]}}, and the list grows by one id for each tool hint that goes away (viewer.tool.hand, viewer.tool.ruler, viewer.tool.comment, viewer.tool.smart, viewer.tool.rect, viewer.tool.ellipse, viewer.tool.poly, viewer.tool.marker). The v0.28.1 smoke blocks the call, so it is tried again on each slide, which is why seeded-formats and the first outline-typing attempt fail. The agent account did not get the write on a plain open in 20 opens. It came when the hint closed, on ⇧I and on every tool change.

Likely cause: The effect cleanup in apps/web/src/annotations/hints-once.ts:39 calls markSeen whenever the tool, the wanted flag or the ready flag changes while the stage stays mounted. wantsHints in apps/web/src/viewer/slide-stage.tsx:468 depends on the workspace, which settles after the first render, so a late change marks the Select hint as seen with no user action. The write itself is serverWrites in apps/web/src/hints/hints-seen.ts:190.

10/tasks/{id}/submitted hangs on Loading the review

Without a slide in the address the page stays on "Loading the review" forever and asks the API for /slides//objects, /slides//decisions and four more, all 404.

Likely cause: apps/web/src/routes/tasks.$taskId.submitted.tsx:13 passes an empty slide id to SlideSubmitted instead of going to the task.

11Adjudication and the disagreement queue cannot be worked on the seed

/tasks/{id}/adjudicate answers 404 on /api/review-tasks/{id}/adjudication and shows "Nothing is queued for you". Every seeded queue is locked with "The queue opens when every reviewer has submitted", or empty. Clicking the one listed object does nothing.

Likely cause: The seed (seed_states in apps/api/src/parfocal_api/showcase.py:648) has no task where all reviewers submitted with an open disagreement, and no adjudicator is set on any task.

12An annotate task opens with mode=guided in the address, and mode=cells falls back silently

My work, Start on Annotation example lands on ?mode=guided while the screen is the Annotate viewer. mode=cells on a task with no cell sample shows the Review viewer and keeps mode=cells in the address.

Likely cause: My work passes the task start_mode for every task kind. viewerModeOf in apps/web/src/viewer/viewer-mode.ts:44 picks the mode but the route in apps/web/src/routes/projects.$projectId.slides.$slideId.tsx does not rewrite the address.

13A finished job in the Jobs tray opens an empty upload wizard

The tray says "click one for its steps". The row opens /projects/{id}/upload?scene=done with "Add slides or result files first". The job page /projects/{id}/jobs/{job id} does show the job.

Likely cause: The tray row link in apps/web/src/screens/jobs points at the upload wizard scene instead of the job route.

14The PDF preview does not close with Esc

On the evaluation report, Preview the PDF opens and prints, but Esc leaves it open. Only the Close the preview button works.

Likely cause: apps/web/src/screens/evaluation/pdf-overlay.tsx has no Escape handling.

15A slide that cannot open still says Opening and offers every tool

For the zip slides and for Missing file.svs the top bar keeps "Opening", the whole Annotate rail stays active, the Display tab is empty, and Try again is offered although a retry cannot help for an unsupported format.

Likely cause: apps/web/src/viewer/live-top-bar.tsx keeps the opening state after a failure, and apps/web/src/viewer/open-failure-alert.tsx always draws Try again.

16Console and network noise on normal pages

Home, the project page and My work ask for the thumbnail of Missing file.svs and get 404 each time. Home and the annotate task ask /api/review-tasks/{id}/slides/{id}/decisions for an annotate task and get 409.

Likely cause: apps/web/src/screens/slide-thumb.tsx requests a thumbnail for a slide with no file. The resume card on home and the viewer call the decisions endpoint without checking the task kind.

17The Compare with RT-1 button gives no sign that it did anything

On the evaluation report the button changes no address, opens nothing and sends nothing that could be seen.

Likely cause: compare in apps/web/src/screens/evaluation/evaluation-screen.tsx:152 adds a comparison block further down the page and returns silently when one exists.

18The browser tab is always named Parfocal

Every page and every slide has the same tab title, so several open slides cannot be told apart.

Likely cause: No route sets document.title (apps/web/src/routes/__root.tsx).

19Dead ends and silent fallbacks in addresses

/kpi and /study have no menu and no way back. /projects/new goes to home without opening the New project window. ?tab=results and ?tab=report show Slides, ?tab=people shows Settings. The case header on the Slides tab does nothing when clicked. /sign-in shows the sign-in form to a person who is signed in.

Likely cause: apps/web/src/routes/kpi.tsx and study.tsx render outside the shell. projectSearch in apps/web/src/search/route-searches.ts:124 still accepts tab names that no longer exist.

20Read only guided review still coaches the person to answer

On a task assigned to someone else the banner says "Read only", yet the coach steps say "Answer with one of the buttons, or press K, X or U".

Likely cause: apps/web/src/screens/review/guided-coach.ts does not check the read only state.

21During the v0.28.1 rollout a page stayed on Loading Parfocal

At 17:14 one slide load hung for 36 seconds with "Failed to load module script" because an old page asked for a chunk that was gone.

Likely cause: No reload on a failed chunk import in apps/web/src/main.tsx.

22Small wording and data slips

"1 slides", "1 reviews not submitted", "Rhea Reviewer has 1 slides left", "Pick who takes the slides..", and "He can fix it" for Ada. Two workspaces share the initials ČM in the switcher. The slide switcher says "The AI is reading, 100%, Processing" for a slide with no result. The seeded signed report says the AI flagged 8 regions and 6 were confirmed, next to 0 deposits.

Likely cause: Plural forms in apps/web/src/locales/en.po and seed text in apps/api/src/parfocal_api/showcase.py.

Why the zip slides do not open

  • Both slides fail the same way, in the browser, before any pixel is asked for.
  • GET /api/slides/{id}/tile-access answers 200 with format "mirax" (or "dicom") and original "original.zip".
  • GET /tiles/{id}/levels.json answers 200. The table comes from OpenSlide for MIRAX and from wsidicom for DICOM. Its levels have sizes but no page and no directory offset, and the MIRAX tile sizes are null, so there is nothing a browser reader could follow.
  • The browser then stops. signedOpenRequest in packages/viewer-engine/src/access/signed-slide.ts:300 builds the request, and registry.open in packages/viewer-engine/src/pixel-source/registry.ts:35 throws UnsupportedFormatError, because createDefaultPixelSourceRegistry at registry.ts:82 has openers for the TIFF family, NDPI, BIF and Zarr only. apps/web/src/viewer/open-failure.ts:31 turns that into the message on screen.
  • Two more things would stop it even with a reader. A direct range read of /tiles/{id}/original.zip with a valid token answered 403. apps/api/src/parfocal_api/tile_access.py:158 closes the whole file when a slide has no restricted ranges file, and apps/edge/src/tiles.ts:327 then refuses every range. GET /tiles/{id}/tile-index.json answers 404, so no tile index was written at ingest.
  • Nothing converts these slides either. The seed in apps/api/src/parfocal_api/showcase.py:178 points the slide at the fixture zip itself, and no converted pyramid exists next to it.
  • The smoke already knows: apps/web/smoke/seeded-formats.spec.ts:76 skips the MIRAX and DICOM tests. PROTO-100 (a slide that came in a zip reads as its own format) only renames these slides and will not make them open.

Do the viewer tabs and tools fit the task

  • Guided review has no rail and three tabs, which fits. The opinion questions come at the end, which fits.
  • Review has Select, Pan, Measure, Comment, Smart select and Compare with Objects, Display, Comments and Opinion, which fits. Smart select is odd in a mode where the reviewer does not draw.
  • Annotate has the full rail. Its Objects tab holds Find nuclei, counts and measurements, while the drawn shapes, groups and result sets sit under Display. A person looking for what they drew opens the wrong tab first.
  • Cells mode read only drops Comment and the Comments and Opinion tabs, which fits.
  • A slide that failed to open keeps every tool and tab, which does not fit.
